notes: HamsterToken (src/HamsterToken.sol) is a plain fixed-supply ERC-20 for HAMSTER (@hamsterhourgame: bet on hamster, lose to earn $HAMSTER). Name HAMSTER, symbol HAMSTER, 18 decimals. The constructor takes no arguments and mints INITIAL_SUPPLY = 1,000,000,000 * 10^18 = 1000000000000000000000000000 base units once to msg.sender, which is the launch factory. Nothing can mint afterwards: there is no owner, minter, pause, blacklist, freeze, seizure, burnFrom, proxy, upgrade path, delegatecall or selfdestruct. Ordinary transfers carry no tax, fee, burn or rebasing, so the factory's transfer to the MerkleDistributor, the claims out of it, the single-sided pool seed through the Uniswap v4 PoolManager and trader swaps each move exactly what they say. There are no application contracts, no linked libraries and no initialization calls. The game described in the brief is branding only: no wagering, randomness or reward logic is deployed, and any future game must fund HAMSTER rewards from existing tokens.
